title: A Robin's Small Stages Through the Year
caption:
ORANGE CHEST, WINTER PERCHES AND REED SONGS. European robins across real locations. #WildVox #Robin #Birdwatching

narration_timeline.text: A European robin pauses on a garden fence, its orange breast easy to recognize.
Another robin perches in a winter park, surrounded by bare and quiet branches.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic footage: 2022-01-03 LJUBLJANA Krajinski park Tivoli PASSERIFORMES Erithacus rubecula TAŠČICA 2.webm

narration_timeline.text: In spring and summer, separate robins appear among low branches and leafy park greenery.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic footage: 2022-03-28 LJUBLJANA Krajinski park Tivoli PASSERIFORMES Erithacus rubecula TAŠČICA.webm and 2022-06-14 LJUBLJANA Krajinski park Tivoli PASSERIFORMES Erithacus rubecula TAŠČICA.webm

narration_timeline.text: By early autumn, another robin pauses in a different part of the park.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic footage: 2022-09-24 LJUBLJANA Krajinski park Tivoli PASSERIFORMES Erithacus rubecula TAŠČICA.webm

narration_timeline.text: Two robins sing from reeds in separate recordings, turning small perches into places for song.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic footage: European robin singing in reeds 01.webm and European robin singing in reeds 02.webm

narration_timeline.text: Finally, a robin sings again in a different view, ending with the sound that makes this bird memorable.
